# Church 244

> Kingdom Minded — A Christ-centered, Spirit-filled church community at 129 Center St, Suite F, Richland, MS 39218 where you belong and you're family. Phone: (601) 317-1482.

Church 244 is a welcoming, Bible-believing Christian church located in Richland, Mississippi (serving Richland, Florence, Pearl, Brandon, and South Jackson, MS). Led by Pastor Josh Watts and his wife Jeanette, Church 244 centers everything around Jesus Christ, Spirit-led worship, biblical teaching, and authentic family community. Come as you are — there is no dress code and our doors are always open.

## Location, Service Times & Leadership
- **Address**: 129 Center St, Suite F, Richland, MS 39218
- **Phone**: (601) 317-1482
- **Sunday Morning Worship**: Sundays, 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM (Main worship gathering with contemporary Spirit-led worship, Children's Ministry, and biblical preaching)
- **Wednesday Bible Study & Fellowship**: Wednesdays, 6:30 PM – 8:00 PM (Fellowship and prayer at 6:30 PM, Adult Bible Study at 7:00 PM)
- **Church 244 Youth (Ages 13–19)**: Thursdays, 6:30 PM – 8:00 PM (Teen worship, Bible study, and community)
- **Leadership**: Lead Pastor Josh Watts & Jeanette Watts; Praise & Worship Leaders Nick & Amy Hare; Youth Pastors Nick & Shanna Weeks; Children's Ministers London & Andrew Perkins; Men's & Women's Ministry Matthew & Lexie Owens
